mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN hrm_resign_handover h ON h.id = ( SELECT h2.id FROM hrm_resign_handover h2 WHERE h2.employee_id = e.id AND h2.deleted = 0 ORDER BY h2.create_time DESC, h2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = e.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = e.dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_post p ON p.id = e.post_id AND p.deleted = 0
CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN u.id IS NULL THEN 3 WHEN u.status = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

(CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND (u.id IS NULL OR u.status = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN COALESCE(h.customer_check_status, 0) = 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) + (CASE WHEN COALESCE(h.task_check_status, 0) = 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) + (CASE WHEN COALESCE(h.document_check_status, 0) = 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) + (CASE WHEN COALESCE(h.asset_check_status, 0) = 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) + (CASE WHEN COALESCE(h.settlement_check_status, 0) = 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)

e.id AS employee_id, e.emp_code, e.name, e.dept_id, d.dept_name, e.post_id, p.post_name, e.hire_date, e.resign_date, AS account_status, CASE WHEN u.id IS NOT NULL AND u.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS account_enabled, h.id AS handover_id, h.handover_date, h.handover_to_employee_id, h.handover_to, COALESCE(h.status, 0) AS handover_status, COALESCE(h.customer_check_status, 0) AS customer_check_status, COALESCE(h.task_check_status, 0) AS task_check_status, COALESCE(h.document_check_status, 0) AS document_check_status, COALESCE(h.asset_check_status, 0) AS asset_check_status, COALESCE(h.settlement_check_status, 0) AS settlement_check_status, h.archive_time, AS risk_count, CASE WHEN COALESCE(h.status, 0) = 2 AND () = 0 THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN (e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND (u.id IS NULL OR u.status = 0)) OR COALESCE(h.customer_check_status, 0) = 3 OR COALESCE(h.task_check_status, 0) = 3 OR COALESCE(h.document_check_status, 0) = 3 OR COALESCE(h.asset_check_status, 0) = 3 OR COALESCE(h.settlement_check_status, 0) = 3 OR () >= 3 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'MEDIUM' END AS risk_level
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM org_employee e
WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.status = 3
AND e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND e.dept_id = #{deptId}
AND COALESCE(h.status, 0) = #{status}
AND (COALESCE(h.status, 0) <> 2 OR () > 0)
ORDER BY e.resign_date DESC, e.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN center.handover_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_progress, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN center.handover_status <> 2 OR center.risk_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS risk_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN center.account_status IN (0, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS account_risk_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN center.handover_status = 2 AND center.risk_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closed_count FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(h.status, 0) AS handover_status, AS account_status, AS risk_count FROM org_employee e
WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.status = 3 ) center

SELECT FROM org_employee e
WHERE e.id = #{employeeId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.status = 3 LIMIT 1
